L1_local_horizon.justification: a 16-step horizon admits no macroscopic amplification of rounding (the long-horizon amplification v1 observed needs thousands of steps); the bound sits about five orders above double rounding of the correction
L1_local_horizon.rule: from the identical complete state of every boundary A, B and C (the native envelope, decoded exactly into the R3 laboratory's K1 state: W, H unpacked, a), 16 K1 steps of the next experience natively and in the unchanged R3 laboratory engine: max|W_native - W_lab| / max(1, max|W_lab|) <= 1e-10

L2_consolidation.justification: a single closed-form computation; no dynamics
L2_consolidation.rule: at every boundary, the native (H, a) equals the laboratory consolidation of the same inputs applied to the native pre-consolidation state (previous native H; the native W of the boundary): relative difference <= 1e-12 for H and for a

decision_equivalence.D1_F: the same substitution into the same-host laboratory rows of every F world gives a decision record equal, in every key and every per-world row, to the laboratory's own decision record (laboratory determinism: two fresh laboratory runs of the first F world reproduce its recorded stages; laboratory transplant probe: every in-process laboratory transplant continuation bitwise)
decision_equivalence.D1_Q: native rows (K1, state removal, reset challenge, W-only control, transplant, state semantics) and the same-host control rows (M0, M1 through the canonical core; removed C1R and C1R's shared W_A through the unchanged laboratory) substituted into the recorded R3 per-world rows; the unchanged R3 gates (experiment.gates) with the native determinism and clean-process transplant results give a decision record equal to the recorded R3 pre-robustness decision record in every key (validity, mechanics, gates, disposition, outcome, controls) and every per-world K1 and causality row; the final disposition with the recorded gate L is OUTCOME_A

descriptive_only: per-stage nmse differences between native and laboratory rows (F) and recorded rows (Q)
the F laboratory's own disposition and outcome
disclosures: The same-host invariants and D1_Q (set Q) were exercised during development of the K1N2-A corrections, on this host and under two forced kernels in a development-only simulation; set Q's native behaviour was already fully disclosed by v1. No F world has been built.
The local horizon (16 steps) and the bounds 1e-10 / 1e-12 are fixed here without measurement on any world.

w_a_equals_samehost_canonical: native W after A equals the same-host canonical W_A bitwise
query_equals_runtime_r1_forward: every native query equals the Runtime R1 executor forward map of the same W bitwise
epoch_and_provenance: epochs 4000/8000/12000/16000 and provenance COMPLETE at every boundary
envelope_round_trip: restore then snapshot is bitwise at every boundary
resident_equals_standalone: the FMS-resident run equals the standalone run bitwise (envelopes)
reset_mechanics: reset after B keeps W and epoch bitwise, empties H and a, provenance RESET; learn C with no correction; read at C; no D
w_only_semantics: the Runtime R1 snapshot of W_B imports UNCONSOLIDATED (H = a = 0, W bitwise, different envelope) and learning C from it equals the reset branch bitwise

state_semantics: full and reset B states answer every query bitwise identically
nothing_refused: no canonical or native step refused

exact_invariants.E3_clean_transplant: every world's B envelope, continued through C and D in one clean child process, equals the uninterrupted run bitwise (both sets)
exact_invariants.E4_native_suite: the qualification build's native K1 tests pass: ctest -R '^ECS_G\.test_ecsg_k1' (refusal atomicity and the transaction refusal contract, complete-state commit, envelope and hostile-input refusal, provenance, SINGLE_WRITER and race-free getters, FMS residency and fault reconciliation, no hot allocation, structural performance gates)
exact_invariants.E5_structural: through the Python control plane on one F world: exactly one native crossing per operation for learn with K = 1, 10 and 4000, query, consolidate, and each transaction call; the K1 heap-allocation counter unchanged across all warm operations

frozen: The K1 law, the native mechanism, the R3 task law, regime, thresholds, gates and disposition rules are frozen; no mechanism or model is tuned.
motivation: K1N-v1 established, as a general property, that on some K1 trajectories rounding-scale perturbations of the R3 reference itself are amplified macroscopically over thousands of steps, and that R3 task data is BLAS-kernel dependent. v2 therefore (1) takes every reference on the host that runs the comparison, (2) decides on exact invariants and decision-bearing quantities, (3) checks numerical agreement only where it is mathematically bounded (one consolidation; a short local horizon from an identical state), and (4) adds a fresh validation set. Nothing in v2 was tuned on any v1 world or outcome; there is no per-world tolerance and no exception list.
